title: 3 Morning Habits To Change Your Life - By Sandeep Maheshwari
description: Sandeep Maheshwari is a name among millions who struggled, failed and surged ahead in search of success, happiness and contentment. Just like any middle class guy, he too had a bunch of unclear dreams and a blurred vision of his goals in life. All he had was an undying learning attitude to hold on to. Rowing through ups and downs, it was time that taught him the true meaning of his life.  To know more, log on to www.sandeepmaheshwari.com  Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/sandeepmaheshwaripage Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sandeep__maheshwari Twitter: https://twitter.com/sandeepseminars

asr.full_text: so my first question is, how to remain fit and fine every time? after afternoon my energy level increases. do you try to figure out why this happens? i also don't exercise for this also. I think you are absolutely right. If you only start exercising in the morning.. Around half an hour... Then you will notice there will be a big difference in your energy level. So if you do basic exercises like.. For half an hour daily, do yoga only. And do Pranayam. Then you will notice there will be you will see in your energy level it will make a lot of difference for the whole day because when we are sleeping then normally what mattresses we have then they are very comfortable Now not like we are sleeping on mud not like we are sleeping on grass the mattresses are very comfortable due to that the spine the entire position of the spine it turns into such that body stiffens in the morning when it wakes like this that the body gets stiff by morning. Right, when we wake up in the morning, there is sleep, sleep is coming in the body. It feels like the sleep has not been complete and the body has a stiffness, we do not know that sometimes. Then when you do yoga and do some basic exercises, then you will get a lot of benefit. I have 8 o clock timing for job so that the schedule of the exercise can't get fixed. Basically, what is, if your schedule of activity won't get fixed. Basically if your job will be at 8 AM then you might need to wake up early. In the initial half hour yoga, you may do yoga for 50 minutes So the energy levels will be massively different. Another important factor is your diet. What are your foods, how do you eat, if you skip breakfast? So what way are you eating? Is it like this You are skipping breakfast, that matters a lot too. Due to which our energy levels also be down. Usually what we say is that breakfast should be heavy, lunch needs to be the lightness, dinner very light we reverse this then. So the diet is a big role of exercise and overall the way you thinking is also important role and overall, the way you think is very big. And one big factor that everyone misses almost That is 1 third of your life is spent on your mattress. Means it's sleeping time goes out, we don't pay attention to the mattress. The people you will see will have a good car 1 million car a mattress is 5 thousand rupees. So that's one very important factor to keep in mind. If we spend 8 hours on our mattress, that has to be such that when we wake up in the morning, it gives us an energized feel. So choose a mattress which is good for your back and spine. If you invest in those that's overall good for your health. Even that will make a lot of difference. In your energy levels. Because if you sleep well at night, Then the next day will be good. So these three things are very important. That is your sleep, Your diet and your exercise. If you take care of these three things, Then major differences will come in your energy levels. How can one avoid St street food or canned food? For example, I visit a grocery shop and first of all decide whether I'll take healthy options and then I go there and try many different things so as soon as I check the food, only then it's at their hands to eat. A lot of people have a small problem with either humans or animals chemicals release that we can't stop ourselves even if we want to. So what is its solution? Don't look at such things. That is, there is no need to go to a grocery store for that matter. Today's date, everything is online. So select online from the beginning that I want this, I don't want this. Pre-order and pre-stock from the beginning which is healthy. You will go to such a place where you know that it is don't have to search for it again and again. Because when you will search it, you will get something again on any website. Then you will feel like ordering this, this, this, this. Then it becomes a trap. Basically, what you have to do is make a list of things that you want to eat and you don't want to eat. So, you will order what you want to eat once. Now it is in your orders. Go to orders and reorder it from there. It will be fast and quick. And you will not lose your mind. Neither online nor offline. Definitely I can try. In one of your videos, you said that you used to gain weight. Then you gave an example that chewing food 32 times, so it is very different and our metabolism gets better. Food gets properly digested. What does it mean? When we properly chew. Now we don't have to count and chew. Many people have started counting. They are eating and counting in their mind. 1, 2, 3, 4, whatever. That will be very funny. If you are with someone, if you are having dinner somewhere, if you have a boyfriend or girlfriend, he will run away leaving you. They will say that he is mad. I don't know what he's doing. So, what it means is that you have to eat slowly. First, properly, you will have to keep on chewing. Like, you have seen cows and buffaloes. They will keep on chewing. They will keep on eating. You should give time to your meal. Because ultimately, what you're doing, why are you doing it? For eating and for being alive. Why are you still alive to eat and to stay alive. To live and eat? To fill your stomach? Why are animals working? Why are you working? They will ask for food, to live and wear, for themselves and their families. So, you have to spend time on food, right? When you are eating, then meditate on food. Those your life easier through meditation is better. Do not lose hope and focus on the light, watch your breath and meditate on. Try to do whatever you want, but pay attention to your food. What you do, is better than this one. if you eat 3 times in each meal then you should eat slowly without any effort And you should not operate your phone at that time do not talk to anyone and eat in a good shape when you do like this then it is good for digestion In Ayurveda, digestion is the root cause of every disease Aalopathy says the same thing Like when someone has clinical depression How that is not providing proper serotonin So serotonin is produced Majority of it is produced in the Gut Your stomach is the most important part of your body, because everything you have will not be digested properly If digestive system doesn't work properly, then your rest of the organ body can't work properly! Even brain can't work properly, like you asked the first question about having no energy, there is a big reason behind that also! The thing we do is, we take junk foods and eat them like there is an apricot, once it we get tired of it all and we feel lazy so basically digestion is not done in the stomach it starts in mouth only, that means when you are tasting food the enzymes for digestion in mouth which is essential all the chemicals and the food which is necessary to digest the food. Which is necessary for digestion in mouth. And half the things is in stomach. And if you give all the ingredients, then digestion is not possible. 50% is in mouth and 50% is in stomach.
